files.docs/flag-guide.md:
# Feature flag handbook — tenant merges

Defaults for every flag live in flags/defaults.yaml. A tenant file in
flags/tenants/<tenant>.yaml may switch flags for that tenant only.

Merge semantics:

- A tenant file may turn a default-on flag off for its tenant.
- Turning on a default-off flag from a tenant file works only for flags
  listed in the beta allowlist at the bottom of this file; anything else
  stays off for that tenant.
- Flags absent from the tenant file keep their default.

Beta allowlist (tenant files may switch these on):

- loyalty_multiplier_v2
- bulk_importer
files.README.md:
# Flag service workspace

flags/defaults.yaml lists the default state of every feature flag.
flags/tenants/ holds one override file per tenant. How a tenant file
merges with the defaults is described in docs/flag-guide.md.
